name: Pedagogical Learning Curriculum Contract
description: Master prompt structure for pedagogical mentoring, structured roadmaps, and hands-on skill acquisition.

required_sections.heading: Role & Pedagogical Persona
required_sections.description: Supportive mentor persona with intuitive pacing and zero condescension.

required_sections.heading: Learning Objectives & Skill Outcomes
required_sections.description: Core competencies, target subject, and learning scope.

required_sections.heading: Prerequisite Knowledge & Concept Tree
required_sections.description: Foundational concepts and cognitive prerequisite graph.

required_sections.heading: Structured Curriculum & Hands-On Milestones
required_sections.description: At least 5 ordered topics, each with one objective and one hands-on exercise (D1 invariant).

required_sections.heading: Verifiable Acceptance Criteria
required_sections.description: Competency assessment criteria and mastery verification.

required_sections.heading: Pedagogical Guardrails & Negative Constraints
required_sections.description: Prohibits advanced jargon without definition, hand-wavy explanations, and incomplete code.

required_sections.heading: Documented Learning Assumptions
required_sections.description: Baseline learner proficiency assumptions and time commitment.

exemplars.scenario: Progressive Concept Curriculum for Beginner to Practitioner
exemplars.pattern: Structure into at least 5 ordered modules with one pedagogical objective and one hands-on coding exercise each, maintaining a supportive tone.
